import pandas as pd

# Load the capital dataset
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')
capital_df.head()

# Drop the 'group' and 'color' columns
capital_df = capital_df.drop(columns=['group', 'color'])

# Filter the data for the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE)
young_bronze_age_df = capital_df[(capital_df['BCE'] >= 500) & (capital_df['BCE'] <= 1100)]

# Extract the PC1 values for the forms of capital
pc1_values = young_bronze_age_df[['ZAxtSchwert', 'ZDolch', 'Zhausgr', 'ZCU_AU', 'Zamber', 'ZMonument', 'ZHort', 'ZSichel', 'ZBeil', 'ZMW', 'ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']]

# Extract the PC1 values at the beginning of the period (1100 BCE)
beginning_period_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]
beginning_period_pc1 = beginning_period_df[['ZAxtSchwert', 'ZDolch', 'Zhausgr', 'ZCU_AU', 'Zamber', 'ZMonument', 'ZHort', 'ZSichel', 'ZBeil', 'ZMW', 'ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']]

# Extract the PC1 values for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_time_horizons_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] < 1100]
subsequent_time_horizons_pc1 = subsequent_time_horizons_df[['ZAxtSchwert', 'ZDolch', 'Zhausgr', 'ZCU_AU', 'Zamber', 'ZMonument', 'ZHort', 'ZSichel', 'ZBeil', 'ZMW', 'ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']]

beginning_period_pc1.mean(), subsequent_time_horizons_pc1.mean()

# Replace commas with periods in numeric columns
numeric_columns = ['ZAxtSchwert', 'ZDolch', 'Zhausgr', 'ZCU_AU', 'Zamber', 'ZMonument', 'ZHort', 'ZSichel', 'ZBeil', 'ZMW', 'ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']
young_bronze_age_df[numeric_columns] = young_bronze_age_df[numeric_columns].apply(lambda x: x.str.replace(',', '.').astype(float))

# Extract the PC1 values at the beginning of the period (1100 BCE)
beginning_period_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]
beginning_period_pc1 = beginning_period_df[numeric_columns]

# Extract the PC1 values for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_time_horizons_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] < 1100]
subsequent_time_horizons_pc1 = subsequent_time_horizons_df[numeric_columns]

beginning_period_pc1.mean(), subsequent_time_horizons_pc1.mean()
